R code loads libpath, project, remotes, version, which renv.lock does not pin.
Code fetches data over the network when it runs (download.file). What the server returns today may differ from what the authors got; a receipt must record each file fetched and its SHA-256.
9 code lines use absolute paths from the authors' machines. A rerun must edit them, and each edit is a logged deviation.
Requires Stata (version 10, 11, 13.1, 4.0, 5.0, 6, 7.0, 8, 8.2, 9.2 named in code); the desk says it has it.
80 file reads use paths built at run time (macros, globs, variables), so triage could not check that those inputs exist.
